changedValues.newValue: Carry the unmerged WI-1112 repair forward, add a safe append-only transition from a historically valid material-review receipt to a newly reviewed request after an authorized profile amendment, and implement digest-bound one-time scope authorization for explicitly selected same-repository Work Items that can run concurrently with independent quotas and truthful partial results.

The current Runtime classifies a receipt whose profile digest changed as invalid before it can identify it as stale under a valid append-only amendment chain; that blocks the current review action. Separately, the current taskAuthorization schema has no atomic per-Work-Item start or declared-check retry quota and cannot represent one owner decision over an exact Work Item set without repeated confirmations or accidental cross-Work-Item authority.

Never infer delivery completion from archive, successor creation, PR creation, or one successful workflow shard; absent, stale, conflicting, or foreign evidence remains pending or unknown.

Implement an append-only material-profile transition that validates the prior receipt against its exact historic Contract, profile, request, manifest, and legal same-WI amendment chain; preserve the old receipt and pointer history, append a transition, and open a new current request.

The transition conveys no approval of the new request and never converts Unknown to Clean. A current review remains bound to the new request/manifest; any new cause, path, blob, hunk, Finding, scanner, policy, scope, or identity change remains unresolved.

Before applying a profile amendment, lint whether an existing receipt can be safely migrated. Refuse unmigratable changes before writing; corrupted, foreign, unbound, or unsupported historic receipts fail closed.

Prepare a deterministic read-only authorization manifest for an explicit list of same-repository Work Item IDs. Bind each member's repository, Work Item, Contract/snapshot, exact scope, actions, public target, budgets, actor, and expiry; one owner decision cannot add members or rewrite the manifest.

Issue separate child grants per Work Item. There is no cross-Work-Item authority inheritance, implicit future member, cross-repository member, or shared usage counter. One member's denial, expiry, failure, or revocation does not alter another member's grant.

Reserve each member's declared start quota atomically across processes. Concurrent requests cannot spend the same member's quota twice; distinct explicitly listed members may run concurrently within their own resource boundary.

Retries apply only to an explicitly named unchanged check with a bounded per-check budget. Preserve the original failure. Before recovery, inspect process, operation receipt, and durable state; an uncertain outcome blocks replay.
Render per-member partial, failed, pending, and successful results independently. Aggregate success is possible only when every required member and check is actually satisfied.
Provide equivalent CLI and MCP payload validation and explanations, plus English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese documentation.

Use at most 900 seconds per local check, one local verification worker, and no more than two additional attempts for the same unchanged local check. WI-1113 hosted CI is capped at five total runs; count automatic triggers, entry failures, and reruns. The current Runtime does not enforce these quotas, so keep an append-only auditable manual ledger until candidate enforcement is proved.

Do not edit workflow definitions, weaken tests, normalize protected evidence, publish secrets or unrelated personal data, merge into main, release, enable production, replace the fixed Runtime, or record native close without its own exact confirmation.

Bind taskAuthorization.publicTarget, the eventual GitHub PR base branch, and its native resourceContext.baseBranch to codex/wi-1111-token-outcome-ci in xinglun/ai-cockpit. Bind the actual PR head to codex/wi-1113-delivery-continuity-parallel-authorization in the provider resource record; the current TaskAuthorizationPolicy has no headBranch field, so do not claim the policy alone binds the head.

Keep Contract.baseRevision=5a942f93acaf0a514a291e39674465feddfa69e7 as the immutable successor/recovery baseline. Record the actual PR comparison base separately (currently the remote WI-1111 branch at 46a4afbcee7a56a2ec1a4b97f8838c8cb077aef9); never overwrite one with the other to make identities appear equal.

Preserve PR #1074 (WI-1111 to main) and PR #1075 (WI-1112 to WI-1111). The current WI-1113 branch starts at the same 5a942 head as #1075, so a new PR to WI-1111 currently includes the inherited WI-1112 diff. It may be created as a draft with that overlap disclosed; it is not ready to merge until #1075 changes are already in the WI-1111 base and a fresh exact PR comparison confirms the remaining WI-1113 delta.

Use the existing CI workflow without editing it: pull_request is enabled for any base branch, while push is restricted to main. Count each WI-1113 automatic hosted run, entry failure and rerun against the five-run ledger. A merge into the non-main WI-1111 branch does not trigger this workflow’s push event; after merge, verify the exact merge commit and read back PR/resource state, and report no post-merge hosted CI unless a real run exists for that exact revision.

For pre-merge evidence, bind the actual provider PR number, URL, head branch/revision, base branch/revision and native resourceContext to the WI-1113 Work Item. Treat the Contract baseline, provider comparison base, PR-tested merge revision and final merge commit as separate identities and preserve each exact value.
